appendDesc.Memory Management and Caching: Also covers BytesToBytesMap, the off-heap hash map used by hash aggregation and joins, and its growth strategy.

tour.title: BytesToBytesMap: an off-heap hash map
tour.description: BytesToBytesMap stores keys and values as raw bytes in memory pages obtained from TaskMemoryManager, with open addressing over a long array. HashMapGrowthStrategy decides how the array grows, and the map can spill or hand its records to UnsafeExternalSorter when memory runs short.
